occurrences.english: Create an account and type your legal concern in English, Hindi, or Punjabi. Browser speech capture is optional and may use browser vendor servers. Only final text that you explicitly review is added to your intake; saving always requires your action.

Create or edit a manual summary and review its language, category, and urgency. AI assistance needs separate consent and a configured provider. AI and speech accuracy are not guaranteed. A summary is information for your consultation, not legal advice.

Select an approved advocate and an available slot. Approve sharing the chosen summary version with that advocate. A request reserves a slot while it awaits acceptance and expires at the earlier of the slot start or 24 hours. Either participant can cancel a pending or accepted request.
